review.rationale: Primary review of all 94 entries on the official Clemson ECE people page (40 faculty and 8 joint-faculty cards plus the adjunct, emeritus and contacts tables), reconciled with a full-roster independent Haiku audit. Joint-faculty professors are joint_secondary; staff, adjuncts, visiting, teaching-track and professor-of-practice entries and the emeritus table are excluded (three emeritus-table rows with generic professor titles follow the department's own emeritus classification).
review.independent_review_scope: Full-roster independent audit of 94 directory entries.
